verdict.why: Request bodies are streamed to sub-agents, so an unread upload is now cancelled instead of being drained by the parent.

draft.detail: routeSubAgentRequest now passes req.body through as a stream.

test.error: FAIL: routeSubAgentRequest read the whole request body (8 of 8 chunks) before dispatching

source.quote: Both call sites now pass `req.body` through as a stream.

`Agent._cf_forwardToFacet` and `routeSubAgentRequest` both did `forwardInit.body = await req.arrayBuffer()` before dispatching to a child facet, materialising the entire request body in the parent's isolate.
